newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates close steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates close steady.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Wednesday amid less buying by textile mills, which have already bought stocks to meet export orders, dealers said.
One dealer said the low buying interest had kept the market stable.

In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety fluctuated between 2,375 and 2,410 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and the MNH-93 between 2,600 and 2,615 rupees per maund, the dealer said. The were likely to open stable on Thursday.
